title: VoiceDAO
tagline: VoiceDAO is a social decentralized community where users create a profile to join, post and interact in the community while also carrying tasks assigned in the DAO
description: VoiceDAO is a social DAO where users connect, create a profile, and join the community. It allows users to post(both images and videos using Nft.storage) and discuss things happening in the community, edit their profile and follow other members of the community, join the DAO, choose roles and complete tasks
how_its_made: The project is created using the React framework, ethers library is used to connect with the smart contracts, Lens API is used to enable users to create a profile, join the community, make posts/comments, edit profiles, and follow other users. Skill Wallet is used for authentication, with the partner's agreement that creates a DAO and gives access to the dashboard for the DAO to be managed. Covalent API is used to get DAO contracts event logs. NFT.storage is used to upload images and videos to the application
